summary: In this scheduling run, a total of 1267 passes were evaluated. Out of these, 280 were successfully scheduled, while 987 were not. Among the scheduled passes, 63 of the 65 priority-1 passes were allocated, and 2 were dropped. The 987 dropped passes can be categorized into two groups: 688 of these had alternative contacts later in the window, with a median wait time of 464.9 minutes, and the remaining 299 had no alternative within the planning window.
